correctness.rationale: PASS: The generalized Vandermonde determinant factors as the nonzero Vandermonde product times h₂(z₁,…,z₄)=Σ_{i≤j}z_i z_j. Write a primitive 3p-th root as ωζ with ω primitive third and ζ primitive p-th; collecting pair-sum residues gives coefficients B_b=n_{0,b}+n_{1,b}ω+n_{2,b}ω². Since [Q(ω,ζ):Q(ω)]=p−1, vanishing forces all B_b equal, hence n_{a,b}=v_a+t_b with min(v_a)=0 and 10=p|v|+3T. The only possible cases are p≥11 (impossible divisibility), p=7 (histogram (8,1,1), excluded by the exhaustive fifteen ternary histograms), and p=5 (histogram (10,0,0), forcing all columns into one mod-3 class). For p=5, the four distinct p-residues are four of five fifth roots and h₂=0 by the omitted-root generating identity; the first three Vandermonde rows give rank exactly 3. The saved checker output is an exact finite corroboration (p=5,7,11,13), not the infinite proof; the symbolic proof covers all primes.
